checklist.SE-CL-001: Reads a drawing set as a set: title block, revision and status, scale, and never scales a missing dimension
checklist.SE-CL-002: Resolves architectural/structural/MEP conflicts by written clarification, never by choosing one
checklist.SE-CL-003: Reads specifications: prescriptive versus performance, MasterFormat/NBS organisation
checklist.SE-CL-004: Applies the order of precedence between specification and drawings and never picks the cheaper reading
checklist.SE-CL-005: Names the method of measurement (POMI, NRM2 2nd ed., CESMM4) and knows which applies where
checklist.SE-CL-006: Measures net quantities; waste belongs in the rate, not the quantity
checklist.SE-CL-007: Takes off civil and structural trades in the correct units (m3 concrete by grade, rebar in tonnes, formwork m2 contact, blockwork m2)
checklist.SE-CL-008: Takes off finishes and fit-out (tiles, stone, paint systems) in the correct units
checklist.SE-CL-009: Takes off MEP (cables, containment, points, AC units by capacity) and refuses unlevelable MEP lump sums
checklist.SE-CL-010: Knows product conformity: ECAS mandatory, EQM voluntary, both under MoIAT
checklist.SE-CL-011: Knows fire and life safety approvals: Civil Defence and the UAE Fire and Life Safety Code 2018
checklist.SE-CL-012: Establishes the governing authority from the location and free zone before naming it (e.g. Trakhees)
checklist.SE-CL-013: Knows utility and testing approvals: DEWA/Shams Dubai and Dubai Central Laboratory
checklist.SE-CL-014: Knows green building rules: Al Sa'fat levels and Silver minimum, Estidama Pearl minimums
checklist.SE-CL-015: Exact specs or the quote line is held; the trade's spec checklist decides; never fills a spec with a guess
checklist.SE-CL-016: Applies the exact-spec rule to services (scope, deliverables, licences, service levels)
checklist.SE-CL-017: Requires submittals and checks the certificate covers the exact model offered
checklist.SE-CL-018: Qualifies an inquiry for completeness before matching and holds it with one specific question when incomplete
checklist.SE-CL-019: Adapts BANT and MEDDIC to procurement qualification
checklist.SE-CL-020: Judges budget realism against a documented market band
checklist.SE-CL-021: Knows BOQ structure: preamble, preliminaries, measured work; suppliers fill rates, not quantities
checklist.SE-CL-022: Handles prime cost and provisional sums correctly
checklist.SE-CL-023: Builds and checks a unit rate and reads the cost structure of a quote
checklist.SE-CL-024: Handles arithmetic errors in quotes by written confirmation, never silent correction
checklist.SE-CL-025: States prices only from labelled evidence and cites UAE cost benchmarks with their limits
checklist.SE-CL-026: Compares lead times for long-lead items as carefully as price
checklist.SE-CL-027: Presents quotes VAT-exclusive with VAT and TRN shown, and knows the e-invoicing roadmap
checklist.SE-CL-028: Levels quotes like for like (scope, plugs, VAT, delivery, terms)
checklist.SE-CL-029: Separates exclusions, qualifications and clarifications and runs a written clarification protocol
checklist.SE-CL-030: Marks every line compliant/deviation/not stated and ranks compliant before cheaper non-compliant
checklist.SE-CL-031: Treats an abnormally low quote as a risk signal: neither recommends nor hides it
checklist.SE-CL-032: Runs weighted evaluation on total cost of ownership, not unit price
checklist.SE-CL-033: Holds a flagged quote and sends the supplier exact fixes in English within the 24-hour hold
checklist.SE-CL-034: Produces the comparison report and measures time to comparison and the share with 3+ complete quotes
checklist.SE-CL-035: Verifies the mandatory six before a supplier is matched
checklist.SE-CL-036: Verifies a licence at the right issuer and checks declared trades sit within licensed activities
checklist.SE-CL-037: Knows vetting red flags, sanctions screening scope (EOCN lists) and PDPL duties for contact data
checklist.SE-CL-038: Runs the licence expiry watch: asks at 30/14/7 days, pauses an expired supplier
checklist.SE-CL-039: Runs the no-exact-spec offer loop: never accepts for the customer, silence is not yes, apology on no
checklist.SE-CL-040: Never offers an alternative that lacks a required UAE approval
checklist.SE-CL-041: Shows alternates and options separately from the base ranking
checklist.SE-CL-042: Never discloses a competitor's price, identity or terms; neutral marketplace conduct
checklist.SE-CL-043: Follows the negotiation sequence: level and clarify first, know the BATNA, manage anchoring
checklist.SE-CL-044: Uses levers beyond price (payment terms, retention, delivery, scope split)
checklist.SE-CL-045: Knows retention, advance payment guarantees and defects liability versus warranty
checklist.SE-CL-046: Knows decennial liability and the new UAE Civil Code (FDL 25/2025)
checklist.SE-CL-047: Knows when a contract is formed (quotation, LPO) and how quote validity and escalation work
checklist.SE-CL-048: Knows UAE payment practice: cycles, pay-when-paid, late-payment interest, cheques/PDC, limitation
checklist.SE-CL-049: Knows liquidated damages, variations and suspension for non-payment under UAE law
checklist.SE-CL-050: Knows Incoterms 2020 and how to compare delivered-to-site versus ex-warehouse quotes
checklist.SE-CL-051: Structures framework and rate agreements (no guaranteed volume, indexed capped escalation)
checklist.SE-CL-052: Exact trade match or none; no nearest trade; a missing trade is added first
checklist.SE-CL-053: Knows the founder hard rules over the seat's work
checklist.SE-CL-054: States the reveal fee and non-response rules exactly and routes money questions to the accountant
checklist.SE-CL-055: Writes to suppliers always in English and to customers in their inquiry language
checklist.SE-CL-056: Owns the supplier onboarding funnel stage by stage, measured as stage conversion
checklist.SE-CL-057: Designs the supplier performance score (OTIF, reliability), feeds it to matching fairly with cold start
checklist.SE-CL-058: Sends each supplier a monthly scorecard against its trade, in English, naming no competitor
checklist.SE-CL-059: Measures liquidity and fill rate, detects and prioritises supply gaps and briefs marketing to recruit
checklist.SE-CL-060: Segments categories with the Kraljic matrix
checklist.SE-CL-061: Measures and reduces leakage (deals completed off-platform)
checklist.SE-CL-062: Owns the inquiry pipeline and rescues stalled inquiries (no quote 48 h after matching, busy suppliers)
checklist.SE-CL-063: Runs customer lifecycle duties: concierge, activation 3/5/10 days, follow-up day 3/14, 60-day win-back
checklist.SE-CL-064: Reasons post-reveal dispute findings from evidence for the CEO to decide
checklist.SE-CL-065: Runs win/loss review and case memory, and keeps learning through the gap sweep and self-review
checklist.SE-CL-066: Routes work to the owning seat and closes every handoff it opens; handles supplier non-response
checklist.SE-CL-067: Uses the commercial and marketplace glossary correctly in English and Arabic
checklist.SE-CL-068: Knows electronic acceptance, signatures and records under FDL 46/2021

items.q_en: What do I read first on a drawing before taking quantities?
items.q_ar: ماذا أقرأ أولاً في المخطط قبل حصر الكميات؟
items.q_reworded: A contractor just emailed us a set of PDFs for a tender. Before anyone counts anything, what should be checked on each sheet?
answer_must: Check the title block: drawing number, discipline, scale and status
Check the revision and its date so the latest issue is priced

items.q_en: The drawing says do not scale. The dimension is missing. What do I do?
items.q_ar: المخطط يقول لا تقس بالمسطرة والبُعد مفقود. ماذا أفعل؟
items.q_reworded: One wall on the plan has no length written and the sheet is marked NTS. Can I just measure it with a ruler?
answer_must: No - a missing dimension is never scaled off the drawing
Ask the customer or designer in writing for the dimension

items.q_en: Which drawing file formats can a customer upload?
items.q_ar: ما صيغ ملفات المخططات التي يمكن للعميل رفعها؟
items.q_reworded: The client wants to send us his Revit model and some JPG photos of sketches. What will the platform accept?
answer_must: Only PDF or CAD files (DWG/DXF) are accepted for drawings

items.q_en: The architectural and MEP drawings disagree. Which one do I price?
items.q_ar: المخططات المعمارية والكهروميكانيكية متعارضة. أيهما أسعّر؟
expected_facts: written clarification rather than choosing one
items.q_reworded: The ceiling height on the interiors sheet does not match the duct routing on the mechanical layout. Which should the supplier quote against?
answer_must: Neither by choice: list the conflict with drawing numbers and revisions
Send a written clarification to the customer before pricing

items.q_en: What is the difference between a prescriptive and a performance specification?
items.q_ar: ما الفرق بين المواصفة الوصفية والمواصفة الأدائية؟
expected_facts: leaving the product to the supplier
items.q_reworded: The spec for the pumps says 'achieve 5 bar at the top floor' and names no brand. What kind of spec is that and what does it mean for quotes?
answer_must: It is a performance specification
The supplier chooses the product, so quotes must be checked against the performance required

items.q_en: The specification and the drawings conflict. Which prevails?
items.q_ar: المواصفة والمخططات متعارضة. أيهما يسود؟
items.q_reworded: The written spec calls for 20 mm porcelain but the floor plan legend says 10 mm. The client asks which we should price.
answer_must: The contract's order of precedence decides
Without one, ask in writing; never choose the cheaper reading

items.q_en: How are specifications usually organised?
items.q_ar: كيف تُنظَّم المواصفات عادة؟
items.q_reworded: I opened a 300-page spec book and I'm lost. How is it normally laid out?
answer_must: By work section, typically CSI MasterFormat divisions or the UK NBS structure

items.q_en: Which methods of measurement are common in the UAE?
items.q_ar: ما طرق القياس الشائعة في الإمارات؟
items.q_reworded: A consultant's BOQ preamble names the rules the quantities follow. Which rule books would you expect to see here in the Emirates?
answer_must: POMI, NRM2 and CESMM4

items.q_en: When did the second edition of NRM2 take effect?
items.q_ar: متى سرت الطبعة الثانية من NRM2؟
items.q_reworded: Which version of the RICS detailed measurement rules is current and since when?
answer_must: NRM2 second edition
Effective from 1 December 2021

items.q_en: Should waste be added to the measured quantity?
items.q_ar: هل يُضاف الهدر إلى الكمية المقيسة؟
expected_facts: allowed for in the rate, not added to the quantity
items.q_reworded: Our steel fixer wants 5% extra on the tonnage for offcuts. Do we bump up the BOQ number?
answer_must: No: quantities are measured net
Waste and offcuts are allowed for in the rate, not the quantity

items.q_en: Which measurement method is used for civil and infrastructure works?
items.q_ar: ما طريقة القياس المستخدمة للأعمال المدنية والبنية التحتية؟
items.q_reworded: The road and drainage package comes with its own bill. What rules is that bill likely measured under?
answer_must: CESMM4, the civil engineering method

items.q_en: In what unit is reinforcement steel measured?
items.q_ar: بأي وحدة يُقاس حديد التسليح؟
items.q_reworded: What unit should rebar appear in on a bill?
answer_must: Tonnes, by bar type and diameter, from the bar bending schedule

items.q_en: How is formwork measured?
items.q_ar: كيف تُقاس الشدات؟
expected_facts: formwork in m2 of contact area
items.q_reworded: How do we quantify shuttering for the slabs and columns?
answer_must: In m2 of contact area, by type of formwork

items.q_en: A supplier priced concrete per truck. Is that comparable?
items.q_ar: سعّر مورد الخرسانة بالشاحنة. هل هذا قابل للمقارنة؟
expected_facts: concrete priced per truck rather than per m3
items.q_reworded: One ready-mix supplier sent a price for 40 loads instead of cubic metres. Can I put it next to the others?
answer_must: Not as it stands: concrete is compared per m3 by grade
Ask the supplier to restate per m3

items.q_en: How is blockwork measured?
items.q_ar: كيف يُقاس البلوك؟
expected_facts: blockwork in m2 by block thickness
items.q_reworded: The mason priced block walls per piece. What unit should a take-off use?
answer_must: Square metres, stating the block thickness

items.q_en: How is paint measured in a take-off?
items.q_ar: كيف يُقاس الدهان في حصر الكميات؟
expected_facts: paint in m2 of surface stating the full system
items.q_reworded: What should a painting line in the take-off say, apart from the area?
answer_must: Paint in m2 of surface
State the full system: primer, coats and product

items.q_en: A tiling supplier added 10% to my quantity. Is that right?
items.q_ar: أضاف مورد البلاط 10% إلى كميتي. هل هذا صحيح؟
expected_facts: changed the quantity, not the rate
items.q_reworded: The ceramic contractor's quantity is 10% higher than our measured area. Is that acceptable?
answer_must: No: he changed the quantity rather than the rate
Waste is priced in the rate; the measured quantity stays net

items.q_en: How are cables measured?
items.q_ar: كيف تُقاس الكابلات؟
expected_facts: cables in linear metres by size
items.q_reworded: How does the electrical bill quantify the wiring runs?
answer_must: Cables in linear metres by size, cores and type

items.q_en: A supplier quoted complete MEP as one lump sum. What do I do?
items.q_ar: سعّر مورد الأعمال الكهروميكانيكية كاملة بمبلغ مقطوع واحد. ماذا أفعل؟
items.q_reworded: The MEP contractor sent one number for electrical, plumbing and HVAC together. Is that usable for comparison?
answer_must: A single MEP lump sum cannot be levelled against other quotes
Ask for a breakdown by system and item

items.q_en: How are air-conditioning units described in a take-off?
items.q_ar: كيف توصف وحدات التكييف في حصر الكميات؟
expected_facts: cooling capacity in kW or TR
items.q_reworded: Two quotes both say '10 split units'. What details must be stated before comparing them?
answer_must: Each unit's type and cooling capacity in kW or TR
Also refrigerant, efficiency rating and power supply

items.q_en: Who issues ECAS certificates for regulated products?
items.q_ar: من يصدر شهادات ECAS للمنتجات المنظمة؟
items.q_reworded: A water heater importer asks which government body certifies his products for sale here. Who is it?
answer_must: MoIAT, the Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology
MoIAT absorbed ESMA in 2020

items.q_en: Which code does Dubai Civil Defence apply to fire systems?
items.q_ar: ما الكود الذي يطبقه الدفاع المدني بدبي على أنظمة الحريق؟
expected_facts: UAE Fire and Life Safety Code of Practice (2018 edition)
items.q_reworded: For sprinklers and alarms in a Dubai building, which rulebook does the fire authority use?
answer_must: The UAE Fire and Life Safety Code of Practice, 2018 edition, applied by Dubai Civil Defence

items.q_en: Who approves building work in Jebel Ali?
items.q_ar: من يعتمد أعمال البناء في جبل علي؟
items.q_reworded: The warehouse fit-out is inside JAFZA. Do we go to Dubai Municipality for the permit?
answer_must: No: in Jebel Ali and other PCFC zones Trakhees issues building permits

items.q_en: Who approves a solar connection in Dubai?
items.q_ar: من يعتمد توصيل الطاقة الشمسية في دبي؟
items.q_reworded: A villa owner wants rooftop panels connected to the grid in Dubai. Who signs that off?
answer_must: DEWA, under the Shams Dubai initiative
Through a DEWA-enrolled solar contractor

items.q_en: Where are building materials tested in Dubai?
items.q_ar: أين تُفحص مواد البناء في دبي؟
items.q_reworded: The consultant wants lab test certificates for the blocks we supply in Dubai. Where are they usually issued?
answer_must: Dubai Central Laboratory of Dubai Municipality

items.q_en: Which authority governs this plot? The customer did not say.
items.q_ar: أي جهة تحكم قطعة الأرض هذه؟ لم يذكر العميل.
expected_facts: ask the location and the free zone
items.q_reworded: A customer asks which permit authority applies to his project but only says 'Dubai'. What do you do?
answer_must: Ask the exact location and whether it is in a free zone before naming an authority

items.q_en: What levels does Al Sa'fat certify?
items.q_ar: ما المستويات التي يمنحها نظام السعفات؟
items.q_reworded: What grades does Dubai's green building rating have?
answer_must: Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum

items.q_en: What Al Sa'fat level must a new building in Dubai reach?
items.q_ar: ما مستوى السعفات الذي يجب أن يبلغه مبنى جديد في دبي؟
items.q_reworded: What is the lowest green rating a new Dubai building is allowed to achieve?
answer_must: At least Al Sa'fat Silver

items.q_en: What is the minimum Estidama rating for a new building in Abu Dhabi?
items.q_ar: ما الحد الأدنى لتقييم استدامة لمبنى جديد في أبوظبي؟
expected_facts: 1 Pearl is the minimum for new buildings
items.q_reworded: A new private villa in Abu Dhabi: how many Pearls does it need at minimum?
answer_must: 1 Pearl minimum for new buildings
2 Pearls for government-funded buildings

items.q_en: Is EQM the same as ECAS?
items.q_ar: هل علامة الجودة EQM هي نفسها شهادة ECAS؟
items.q_reworded: A supplier says his cable has the Emirates Quality Mark so it is the same as the mandatory certificate. True?
answer_must: No: EQM is voluntary
ECAS is the mandatory conformity scheme for regulated products

items.q_en: A quote line is missing a spec the trade requires. Can it be released?
items.q_ar: بند في العرض ينقصه مواصفة تتطلبها الحرفة. هل يُطلق؟
items.q_reworded: A supplier left the tile thickness blank on two lines. Can those lines go to the customer?
answer_must: No: a line missing a required spec is held
Ask for the missing spec

items.q_en: Where does the list of required specs for a trade come from?
items.q_ar: من أين تأتي قائمة المواصفات المطلوبة للحرفة؟
items.q_reworded: Who decides which specs a plumbing quote line must state?
answer_must: The trade's own spec checklist
Loaded in trade_spec_checklist from the trade's knowledge pack

items.q_en: How many trades have a spec checklist after the September build?
items.q_ar: كم حرفة لها قائمة مواصفات بعد بناء سبتمبر؟
items.q_reworded: How many trades in the taxonomy now carry a required-spec list?
answer_must: All 213 trades

items.q_en: Can I fill a missing spec with the standard grade?
items.q_ar: هل يمكنني ملء مواصفة ناقصة بالدرجة القياسية؟
expected_facts: never fills a missing spec with a guess
items.q_reworded: The paint quote doesn't say the grade. Can we assume the usual interior emulsion?
answer_must: No: never fill a missing spec with a guess or a standard grade
Ask the supplier

items.q_en: Do services have specs too?
items.q_ar: هل للخدمات مواصفات أيضاً؟
expected_facts: The rule applies to services too
items.q_reworded: A cleaning company quoted just a monthly price. Is that enough since it's a service, not a product?
answer_must: No: services have specs too
Scope, deliverables, licences, service levels and duration must be stated

items.q_en: What submittals should a quote for a specified product carry?
items.q_ar: ما المستندات التي يجب أن يحملها عرض لمنتج محدد؟
items.q_reworded: A supplier quoted a brand of fire door. What documents should come with that price?
answer_must: The manufacturer's datasheet for the exact model
Country of origin and manufacturer, plus test reports or certificates

items.q_en: The certificate names a product family, not the model offered. Is that enough?
items.q_ar: الشهادة تسمي عائلة المنتج لا الطراز المعروض. هل يكفي؟
items.q_reworded: The approval letter mentions the 'X-series' range, but the quote is for model X-450. Is that covered?
answer_must: Not necessarily: the certificate must cover the exact model offered, not only a family name

items.q_en: What must an inquiry state before matching?
items.q_ar: ماذا يجب أن يذكر الاستفسار قبل المطابقة؟
items.q_reworded: A homeowner typed 'need tiling done, call me'. What is missing before we send it out?
answer_must: The trade and items, quantities with units, specification and location
Hold it and ask for what is missing

items.q_en: What goes in the preliminaries of a BOQ?
items.q_ar: ماذا يتضمن قسم الأعمال التمهيدية في جدول الكميات؟
items.q_reworded: What sits at the front of a bill before the measured items?
answer_must: The preamble and the preliminaries: site set-up, supervision and general costs

items.q_en: What is a prime cost sum?
items.q_ar: ما هو مبلغ التكلفة الأولية؟
items.q_reworded: The bill has 'AED 50,000 for sanitary ware from the nominated supplier'. What is that?
answer_must: A prime cost (PC) sum: a named amount for nominated goods or work
The contractor adds profit and attendance

items.q_en: Can a supplier change the quantities in our BOQ?
items.q_ar: هل يمكن للمورد تغيير الكميات في جدول كمياتنا؟
expected_facts: A supplier fills rates, not quantities
items.q_reworded: A contractor reduced three of our quantities because he thinks they are over-measured. Is that allowed?
answer_must: No: a supplier fills rates, not quantities
He raises the query in writing instead

items.q_en: How is a unit rate built up?
items.q_ar: كيف يُبنى سعر الوحدة؟
items.q_reworded: How would you build up a rate for laying one square metre of block work?
answer_must: Materials per unit plus waste at delivered cost
Plus labour, plant and a share of overheads and profit

items.q_en: Rate times quantity does not equal the amount on a quote line. What do I do?
items.q_ar: السعر × الكمية لا يساوي المبلغ في بند العرض. ماذا أفعل؟
items.q_reworded: On line 12 the quantity times the rate gives AED 4,500 but the amount column says 5,400. Do I just fix it?
answer_must: Never correct it silently
Ask the supplier to confirm in writing which figure stands, per the tender rules

items.q_en: What share of UAE construction cost is materials?
items.q_ar: ما حصة المواد من تكلفة البناء في الإمارات؟
items.q_reworded: Roughly how much of a typical UAE build cost is materials?
answer_must: Around 60%

items.q_en: How do I compare quotes that look different?
items.q_ar: كيف أقارن عروضاً تبدو مختلفة؟
items.q_reworded: Three quotes for the same fit-out look totally different in layout and totals. How do I make them comparable?
answer_must: Level them: confirm scope per line, list exclusions
Plug missing items so the comparison is like for like

items.q_en: Should I show prices with or without VAT?
items.q_ar: هل أعرض الأسعار مع ضريبة القيمة المضافة أم دونها؟
items.q_reworded: Should the comparison table show prices including the 5% tax?
answer_must: Show prices VAT-exclusive
Show VAT separately

items.q_en: How do I mark each quote line in a technical evaluation?
items.q_ar: كيف أصنف كل بند في التقييم الفني؟
items.q_reworded: What labels do you put on each line when checking a quote technically against the request?
answer_must: Compliant, deviation, or not stated

items.q_en: Can a cheaper non-compliant quote be ranked first?
items.q_ar: هل يمكن ترتيب عرض أرخص غير مطابق أولاً؟
expected_facts: never ranked above a compliant one
items.q_reworded: The cheapest quote uses a different cable type than requested. Can it still top the ranking?
answer_must: No: a non-compliant quote is never ranked above a compliant one
Show its deviations and let the customer decide

items.q_en: One quote is 25% below the others. Do we recommend it?
items.q_ar: عرض أقل من الآخرين بنسبة 25%. هل نوصي به؟
expected_facts: do not recommend it and do not hide it
items.q_reworded: A quote came in a quarter cheaper than everyone else. Should we tell the customer it's the best deal?
answer_must: Do not recommend it and do not hide it
Investigate scope misses and show the risk

items.q_en: What does a weighted evaluation do?
items.q_ar: ماذا يفعل التقييم المرجّح؟
expected_facts: multiplies each score by a weight
items.q_reworded: How do we choose between quotes when price is not the only thing that matters?
answer_must: Score each quote on criteria, multiply each score by a weight and sum

items.q_en: Which six items must be verified before a supplier is matched?
items.q_ar: ما البنود الستة التي يجب التحقق منها قبل مطابقة المورد؟
items.q_reworded: Before a new supplier gets requests, what must we have confirmed about him?
answer_must: The mandatory six including name, OTP mobile, email and trade licence
Signed platform terms among them

items.q_en: No supplier can meet the exact spec. Can the seat accept the alternative for the customer?
items.q_ar: لا مورد يستوفي المواصفة بالضبط. هل يقبل المقعد البديل عن العميل؟
expected_facts: never accepted on the customer's behalf
items.q_reworded: None of the bidders can supply the exact chiller model. Can we just pick the closest one for the customer?
answer_must: Never accept an alternative on the customer's behalf
The customer decides yes or no on the stated alternative

items.q_en: The customer did not answer about the alternative. Is that a yes?
items.q_ar: لم يرد العميل بشأن البديل. هل هذه موافقة؟
items.q_reworded: We sent the alternative to the customer three days ago and heard nothing. Can we proceed?
answer_must: Silence is not yes
Wait for an explicit answer

items.q_en: The customer said no to the alternative. What happens to the supplier?
items.q_ar: رفض العميل البديل. ماذا يحدث للمورد؟
items.q_reworded: The customer refused the substitute brand. What do we tell the supplier who offered it?
answer_must: A polite apology; the alternative is not accepted

items.q_en: The alternative lacks Civil Defence approval. Do we offer it?
items.q_ar: البديل يفتقد موافقة الدفاع المدني. هل نعرضه؟
items.q_reworded: The substitute sprinkler head has no Civil Defence approval but is cheaper. Should we put it to the customer?
answer_must: No: it is not offered at all

items.q_en: How is an alternate shown next to the base quote?
items.q_ar: كيف يُعرض البديل بجانب العرض الأساسي؟
expected_facts: never folded into the base ranking
items.q_reworded: A supplier added a cheaper 'option B' brand at the bottom of his quote. How does it appear in the comparison?
answer_must: Separately from the base quote
Never folded into the base ranking

items.q_en: Can I tell a supplier that a competitor is cheaper and by how much?
items.q_ar: هل أخبر مورداً أن منافساً أرخص وبكم؟
items.q_reworded: To push the price down, can I let supplier A know that B came in 8% lower?
answer_must: Never disclose one supplier's price or by how much
You may only say the offer is not yet competitive

items.q_en: What comes before bargaining on price?
items.q_ar: ماذا يأتي قبل المساومة على السعر؟
items.q_reworded: Before we start pushing for discounts, what has to happen first?
answer_must: Level the quotes and clarify scope before bargaining on price

items.q_en: What is the customer's real BATNA?
items.q_ar: ما هو البديل الأفضل الحقيقي للعميل؟
items.q_reworded: If talks with the preferred supplier fail, what is the customer's real fallback?
answer_must: The next-best levelled quote

items.q_en: Besides price, what can we negotiate?
items.q_ar: غير السعر، على ماذا يمكن أن نتفاوض؟
items.q_reworded: The supplier won't move on price. What else can we ask for?
answer_must: Non-price levers such as payment terms and retention
Also delivery schedule or scope split

items.q_en: How much retention is typical and when is it released?
items.q_ar: كم نسبة المحتجزات المعتادة ومتى تُفرج؟
items.q_reworded: The main contractor wants to hold back part of each payment. How much is normal and when is it given back?
answer_must: About 10% withheld from each payment, often capped
Released in parts at completion and after the defects notification period

items.q_en: Does a rate contract guarantee volume?
items.q_ar: هل يضمن عقد الأسعار حجماً معيناً؟
items.q_reworded: If a customer signs a one-year rate contract with a supplier, is the supplier promised a minimum order?
answer_must: Usually no guaranteed volume

items.q_en: What escalation clause is acceptable in a framework?
items.q_ar: ما بند تعديل الأسعار المقبول في اتفاقية إطارية؟
items.q_reworded: A supplier wants prices in the yearly agreement to rise with steel prices. What clause is reasonable?
answer_must: Escalation tied to a named index
With a cap

items.q_en: Can a swimming pool request go to plumbing suppliers?
items.q_ar: هل يمكن إرسال طلب مسبح إلى موردي السباكة؟
items.q_reworded: The customer needs a pool built. Can I send it to plumbers since pools involve pipes?
answer_must: No: there is no nearest mapping
Only swimming pool suppliers

items.q_en: No trade in the taxonomy fits the request. What now?
items.q_ar: لا توجد حرفة في التصنيف تناسب الطلب. ماذا الآن؟
expected_facts: a trade is added before anything is matched to it
items.q_reworded: The request is for a trade we don't have in our list at all. What happens?
answer_must: The trade is added before anything is matched to it
Never match to a nearest trade

items.q_en: What are the hard rules over the sales engineer's work?
items.q_ar: ما القواعد الثابتة على عمل مهندس المبيعات؟
expected_facts: exact specs or the quote is held
items.q_reworded: What are the non-negotiable rules our sales engineer must follow on every request?
answer_must: Exact trade match or none
Exact specs or the quote is held

items.q_en: Is decennial liability still in the new Civil Code?
items.q_ar: هل ما زالت المسؤولية العشرية في قانون المعاملات المدنية الجديد؟
items.q_reworded: A builder asks whether the ten-year structural liability survived the 2026 civil law change. What do you say?
answer_must: Yes, it is retained in the new Civil Code
The 1985 code had it in Articles 880-883; the new code is cited as Articles 821-824

items.q_en: How do BANT and MEDDIC differ when qualifying a procurement inquiry?
items.q_ar: ما الفرق بين BANT وMEDDIC عند تأهيل استفسار شراء؟
items.q_reworded: Our team uses a four-letter sales checklist for simple leads and a longer one for complex deals. Which is which, and when do we use each?
answer_must: BANT is a fast screen of budget, authority, need and timeline for simple high-volume cases
MEDDIC is a deeper method for complex decisions with several stakeholders

items.q_en: The customer says his budget is AED 20,000 for the whole fit-out. How do I judge if that is realistic?
items.q_ar: يقول العميل إن ميزانيته 20 ألف درهم للتشطيب كاملاً. كيف أحكم إن كانت واقعية؟
items.q_reworded: A villa owner insists the job must not cost more than a figure that seems low to me. How should I check his number before matching?
answer_must: Compare it with a documented market band, preferring prices actually quoted on the platform
Tell the customer if it is far below, without letting it silently shape the match

items.q_en: A customer asks how much a square metre of construction costs in Dubai. What may I say?
items.q_ar: عميل يسأل كم تكلفة المتر المربع من البناء في دبي. ماذا يحق لي أن أقول؟
items.q_reworded: Someone on the phone wants a ballpark build cost per metre before he sends any drawings. How do you respond?
answer_must: Answer only from labelled evidence: platform quotes first, then published benchmarks
State the source and its limits; never invent a number

items.q_en: What lead time should I expect for structural steel in Dubai?
items.q_ar: ما مدة التوريد المتوقعة للحديد الإنشائي في دبي؟
items.q_reworded: The client needs the steel frame on site in a month. Is that realistic, and how do lead times affect which quote wins?
answer_must: Published 2025 survey reports structural steel at about 12-18 weeks in Dubai
Lead time is compared as carefully as price

items.q_en: When will mandatory e-invoicing affect our suppliers, and on what model?
items.q_ar: متى سيؤثر الفوترة الإلكترونية الإلزامية على موردينا، وعلى أي نموذج؟
items.q_reworded: A supplier asks whether he will need new invoicing software soon in the UAE. What do you tell him?
answer_must: The UAE is moving to mandatory e-invoicing on a Peppol-based model through accredited service providers
Invoices are reported to the Federal Tax Authority

items.q_en: What is the difference between an exclusion and a qualification in a quote?
items.q_ar: ما الفرق بين الاستثناء والتحفظ في عرض السعر؟
items.q_reworded: The fine print says "price excludes scaffolding" on one quote and "price assumes access from ground floor" on another. How do I treat each?
answer_must: An exclusion removes the item from scope so it must be plugged when levelling
A qualification keeps the item priced only if an assumption holds, so it is clarified in writing

items.q_en: How should a clarification question to a supplier be written?
items.q_ar: كيف ينبغي كتابة سؤال استيضاح إلى مورد؟
items.q_reworded: I want to ask a bidder about some unclear lines on the phone. Is that fine?
answer_must: Clarifications are written, specific, time-bound and recorded
Each question names the quote reference and the line

items.q_en: The quality check flagged a supplier quote. What happens next and in which language?
items.q_ar: رصد فحص الجودة عرض مورد. ماذا يحدث بعد ذلك وبأي لغة؟
items.q_reworded: A bid has errors the system caught. Does the customer see it now, and how is the supplier told?
answer_must: The quote is held and not shown as it stands
The supplier gets the exact fixes in English; the hold lasts 24 hours

items.q_en: What does the weekly comparison KPI measure?
items.q_ar: ماذا يقيس مؤشر المقارنة الأسبوعي؟
items.q_reworded: The CEO wants to know if our comparisons are fast and complete enough. Which numbers do we report?
answer_must: Hours from inquiry to comparison report, median and p90
Share of reports with 3 or more complete quotes, and exclusions flagged

items.q_en: Where do I verify a supplier's UAE trade licence?
items.q_ar: أين أتحقق من الرخصة التجارية لمورد في الإمارات؟
expected_facts: economic department or by free-zone authorities
items.q_reworded: A new supplier uploaded a licence scan. How do I know it is real and covers what he wants to quote?
answer_must: Verify with the issuer: the emirate economic department or the free-zone authority
Check the declared trades are within the licensed activities

items.q_en: A company licensed for building materials trading wants to quote for installation. Can it?
items.q_ar: شركة مرخصة لتجارة مواد البناء تريد تقديم عرض للتركيب. هل يجوز؟
expected_facts: within the activities listed on its licence
items.q_reworded: A trader of tiles wants to also offer laying tiles on our platform. What do we check?
answer_must: Declared trades must be within the activities listed on the licence
A trading licence does not by itself cover installation work

items.q_en: Which signs during supplier vetting justify holding activation?
items.q_ar: ما العلامات أثناء تدقيق المورد التي تبرر تعليق التفعيل؟
expected_facts: licence name differs from the profile
items.q_reworded: Something feels off about a supplier who just registered. What would make you pause him?
answer_must: Mismatched names between licence, profile, bank or invoice
Expired or wrongly issued licence; red flags justify questions, not proof of wrongdoing

items.q_en: Who runs the UAE local sanctions lists and does the platform screen suppliers?
items.q_ar: من يدير قوائم العقوبات المحلية في الإمارات وهل تفحص المنصة الموردين؟
expected_facts: Executive Office for Control and Non-Proliferation
items.q_reworded: An investor asks whether we check suppliers against terrorist lists. Which UAE body keeps those lists?
answer_must: The Executive Office for Control and Non-Proliferation (EOCN)
It administers the Local Terrorist List and related lists

items.q_en: Which law governs the personal data of supplier and customer contacts?
items.q_ar: ما القانون الذي يحكم البيانات الشخصية لجهات اتصال الموردين والعملاء؟
items.q_reworded: A supplier wants us to delete his mobile number from our records. Which UAE law applies?
answer_must: The Personal Data Protection Law, Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021
Processing needs consent or another lawful basis

items.q_en: When does the platform ask a supplier to renew his trade licence, and what happens on expiry?
items.q_ar: متى تطلب المنصة من المورد تجديد رخصته، وماذا يحدث عند انتهائها؟
items.q_reworded: A supplier's licence runs out next week. What has he already received, and can he still get requests after it lapses?
answer_must: Renewal asks at 30, 14 and 7 days before expiry
On expiry he is paused and told; the ask closes only when a new document arrives

items.q_en: Is a supplier's quotation an offer, and when is a contract formed?
items.q_ar: هل عرض سعر المورد إيجاب، ومتى ينعقد العقد؟
items.q_reworded: The customer sent an LPO after the supplier quoted. Do they now have a binding deal?
answer_must: The quotation is normally the offer and the LPO the acceptance
Terms on each document matter; the LPO can itself be an offer

items.q_en: Why must every quote state its validity period?
items.q_ar: لماذا يجب أن يذكر كل عرض مدة صلاحيته؟
items.q_reworded: A customer wants to accept a quote from two months ago at the same price. Can he?
answer_must: Only if still within the stated validity period
Costs are rising, so validity and escalation must be stated

items.q_en: How long do UAE government entities typically take to pay suppliers?
items.q_ar: كم تستغرق الجهات الحكومية في الإمارات عادة للدفع للموردين؟
items.q_reworded: A supplier asks whether a ministry job will tie up his cash for long. What is typical?
answer_must: About 45-60 days for federal and Abu Dhabi government, per a practitioner source
Payment timing is a real cost reflected in prices

items.q_en: Is a pay-when-paid clause enforceable in the UAE?
items.q_ar: هل شرط الدفع عند القبض قابل للتنفيذ في الإمارات؟
items.q_reworded: The main contractor's order says the supplier gets paid only once the client pays him. Is that normal and valid?
answer_must: Distinguish pay-when-paid (timing) from pay-if-paid (condition)
UAE has no statute banning them; enforceability depends on the wording and courts

items.q_en: Can a supplier claim interest on a late commercial payment in the UAE?
items.q_ar: هل يحق للمورد المطالبة بفائدة على دفعة تجارية متأخرة في الإمارات؟
items.q_reworded: A customer paid a supplier four months late. Can the supplier add interest?
answer_must: Yes under the Commercial Transactions Law, Federal Decree-Law No. 50 of 2022
Interest runs from the maturity date

items.q_en: Is a bounced cheque still a crime in the UAE?
items.q_ar: هل لا يزال الشيك المرتجع جريمة في الإمارات؟
items.q_reworded: A supplier wants post-dated cheques from a customer for security. What changed in the law?
answer_must: Federal Decree-Law No. 14 of 2020 decriminalised cheques bounced for insufficient funds
The cheque can be enforced directly as an executory instrument

items.q_en: How long does a supplier have to sue for an unpaid commercial debt?
items.q_ar: كم من الوقت لدى المورد لرفع دعوى على دين تجاري غير مدفوع؟
items.q_reworded: An invoice from 2021 was never paid. Is it too late to claim?
answer_must: Commercial claims between merchants generally must be brought within five years

items.q_en: Can a UAE court change a liquidated damages amount?
items.q_ar: هل يجوز للمحكمة الإماراتية تعديل مبلغ التعويض الاتفاقي؟
items.q_reworded: The order has a delay penalty of 1% per day. Is the supplier stuck with it whatever the actual loss?
answer_must: Liquidated damages are subject to judicial review
A court may adjust them to the actual loss

items.q_en: What is a variation and how should it be handled after the order?
items.q_ar: ما التغيير في الأعمال وكيف يُعالَج بعد الأمر؟
items.q_reworded: Halfway through, the customer wants extra sockets. How is that priced and agreed?
answer_must: A variation is added, omitted or changed scope
It is instructed and priced in writing before the work

items.q_en: The customer is not paying. Can the supplier stop work?
items.q_ar: العميل لا يدفع. هل يجوز للمورد إيقاف العمل؟
items.q_reworded: A supplier has not been paid for two invoices and wants to down tools. What can he do?
answer_must: Suspension under the exception of non-performance
Give notice and follow the contract terms first

items.q_en: How many Incoterms 2020 rules are there?
items.q_ar: كم عدد قواعد إنكوترمز 2020؟
items.q_reworded: An importer quoted CIF Jebel Ali and another DDP site. What framework explains the difference?
answer_must: Incoterms 2020 from the ICC, with 11 rules
They define where risk passes and who pays carriage, insurance and duties

items.q_en: Most of our quotes are local. Which delivery terms really matter to compare?
items.q_ar: معظم عروضنا محلية. أي شروط تسليم تهم فعلاً في المقارنة؟
items.q_reworded: One supplier quotes ex-warehouse Sharjah and another delivered. How do I compare them?
answer_must: Delivered to site versus ex-warehouse or collection, and who offloads
Add delivery and offloading to the ex-warehouse price to compare

items.q_en: How much is the reveal fee and is VAT or a card fee added?
items.q_ar: كم رسم الكشف وهل تُضاف ضريبة أو رسوم بطاقة؟
items.q_reworded: A customer is about to unlock a AED 200,000 quote. What will he pay on top, exactly?
answer_must: 3% of the quote value with no cap and no discount
Nothing added for card payment and no VAT because QuotesDone is not VAT registered

items.q_en: The supplier did not respond after the customer paid to reveal. What happens?
items.q_ar: لم يرد المورد بعد أن دفع العميل للكشف. ماذا يحدث؟
items.q_reworded: I paid to unlock a contractor a week ago and he is ignoring my calls. Do I lose my money?
answer_must: The supplier has 5 working days; chased at 3, CEO decides at day 5
The customer is refunded in full; the supplier owes the refunded amount, the unrecovered processor fee, an AED 500 administrative fee and 12% a year simple interest

items.q_en: In what language do we write to a supplier who wrote to us in Arabic?
items.q_ar: بأي لغة نكتب لمورد راسلنا بالعربية؟
items.q_reworded: A Sharjah contractor messages us on WhatsApp in Arabic about his quote. How do we reply, and what about customers?
answer_must: Suppliers are always written to in English, on every channel
Customers are answered in their inquiry language

items.q_en: How does the seat report supplier onboarding?
items.q_ar: كيف يُبلغ المقعد عن تأهيل الموردين؟
items.q_reworded: We invited 170 suppliers and only one quotes. How should this be reported and fixed?
answer_must: Report stage conversion: delivered, registered, verified, activated, first quote
Delivery is verified in the outbox; a status column is not proof

items.q_en: A supplier was just activated. What does the seat do next?
items.q_ar: تم تفعيل مورد للتو. ماذا يفعل المقعد بعد ذلك؟
expected_facts: a supplier who never quotes adds nothing
items.q_reworded: A newly approved supplier has had no work for three weeks. Why does that matter and what do we do?
answer_must: Activation is not the goal; a supplier who never quotes adds nothing to liquidity
Check his trades and emirates are set and get him a suitable first inquiry quickly

items.q_en: How is OTIF calculated?
items.q_ar: كيف يُحسب مؤشر التسليم في الوقت وبالكامل؟
expected_facts: OTIF = deliveries on time and in full / total deliveries
items.q_reworded: The customer wants to know how reliable a supplier is on deliveries. Which measure would you use and how is it computed?
answer_must: OTIF: deliveries both on time and in full divided by total deliveries

items.q_en: Can a high performance score let a supplier be matched outside his trade?
items.q_ar: هل تسمح درجة الأداء العالية بمطابقة مورد خارج حرفته؟
expected_facts: never lets a supplier bypass a gate
items.q_reworded: Our best-rated electrician wants requests for plumbing too. Does his score help?
answer_must: No: the score ranks only suppliers who passed every hard gate
It never lets a supplier bypass a gate such as exact trade or emirate

items.q_en: How do we stop the performance score from favouring only established suppliers?
items.q_ar: كيف نمنع درجة الأداء من تفضيل الموردين القدامى فقط؟
items.q_reworded: New suppliers complain they never get a chance because old ones always rank higher. What is the fix?
answer_must: A score rewarding only past wins becomes self-reinforcing
Give newcomers a cold-start allowance so they can build a record

items.q_en: What does a supplier's monthly scorecard contain and how is it sent?
items.q_ar: ماذا تحتوي بطاقة الأداء الشهرية للمورد وكيف تُرسل؟
items.q_reworded: A supplier asks how he is doing compared with others in his trade. What does he get from us and when?
answer_must: A monthly e-mail scorecard in English comparing him with his trade
It names no competitor and shows no competitor price

items.q_en: How is marketplace liquidity measured?
items.q_ar: كيف تُقاس سيولة السوق؟
items.q_reworded: The founder asks whether the marketplace is working for customers. Which single measure answers that?
answer_must: Fill rate (match rate): the share of demand that finds suitable supply

items.q_en: What is a supply gap and who recruits to fill it?
items.q_ar: ما فجوة العرض ومن يستقطب لسدّها؟
items.q_reworded: Requests for glazing in Fujairah keep getting no bidders. Whose job is it and what happens?
answer_must: A gap is a trade-and-emirate segment where demand cannot be served well
The sales engineer finds it and briefs marketing, which runs recruitment

items.q_en: What does the Kraljic matrix classify?
items.q_ar: ماذا تصنّف مصفوفة كرالييتش؟
items.q_reworded: How do I decide which categories need careful supplier development versus simple catalogue buying?
answer_must: The Kraljic matrix classifies categories by profit impact and supply risk
Four groups: non-critical, leverage, bottleneck, strategic

items.q_en: What is leakage in a marketplace?
items.q_ar: ما التسرّب في السوق الإلكتروني؟
items.q_reworded: We suspect customers find suppliers here and then deal with them directly next time. What is that called and why does it matter?
answer_must: Leakage: buyers and suppliers use the marketplace to meet, then complete the transaction outside it
It stunts growth and monetisation

items.q_en: A request has had no quote 48 hours after matching. What does the seat do?
items.q_ar: طلب لم يصله عرض بعد 48 ساعة من المطابقة. ماذا يفعل المقعد؟
items.q_reworded: The customer posted his job two days ago and still sees zero bids. What is happening behind the scenes?
answer_must: It is flagged and the invitation is widened to uninvited suppliers in the exact trade and emirate
The customer is told honestly; never widened to a nearest trade

items.q_en: A supplier marked himself busy until next Sunday. Is he matched meanwhile?
items.q_ar: أعلن مورد انشغاله حتى الأحد القادم. هل يُطابَق في الأثناء؟
items.q_reworded: One of our installers is on another big job for two weeks. How does the platform treat him?
answer_must: He is not matched while busy and returns to available on the date
Busy is not counted as non-response

items.q_en: Which pipeline stages does the seat own?
items.q_ar: ما مراحل خط الطلبات التي يملكها المقعد؟
items.q_reworded: Who makes sure a request moves from intake to a hired supplier without waiting for instructions?
answer_must: The sales engineer owns every stage from intake to delivered job
It chases anything stalled rather than waiting for a directive

items.q_en: What happens when a new customer has not posted a request after 3 days?
items.q_ar: ماذا يحدث حين لا ينشر عميل جديد طلباً بعد 3 أيام؟
items.q_reworded: A company signed up last week but never asked for anything. Do we contact them, and how?
answer_must: A nudge at 3 days with no request; a request with no quote is acted on at 5 days
A reasoned message at 10 days

items.q_en: After a reveal, when do we ask the customer whether he hired the supplier?
items.q_ar: بعد الكشف، متى نسأل العميل هل تعاقد مع المورد؟
items.q_reworded: A customer unlocked a supplier last month. Do we ever check how it went?
answer_must: Yes, on day 3 and day 14 after the reveal
The answer is recorded as an outcome feeding the supplier score

items.q_en: Which customers get a win-back message?
items.q_ar: أي العملاء يتلقون رسالة استعادة؟
items.q_reworded: A customer has gone quiet for two months. Do we send him the newsletter?
answer_must: One nudge about his own trades after 60 days with no request and no reveal
Not a generic campaign; campaigns are marketing's

items.q_en: Who decides a post-reveal dispute and what does the sales engineer contribute?
items.q_ar: من يقرر في نزاع ما بعد الكشف وما دور مهندس المبيعات؟
items.q_reworded: A customer says the contractor did half the job; the contractor says the customer changed the scope. Who rules?
answer_must: The sales engineer reasons a finding from both sides' evidence
The CEO seat decides; the sales engineer never decides a refund itself

items.q_en: How does the seat learn from closed outcomes?
items.q_ar: كيف يتعلم المقعد من النتائج المغلقة؟
expected_facts: the buyer's own account is needed
items.q_reworded: We lost five customers who chose not to reveal anyone. How do we find out why?
answer_must: Run a win/loss review on chosen, declined and no-decision outcomes
Use the buyer's own account, not only internal reason codes

items.q_en: What must the seat do before deciding a case?
items.q_ar: ماذا يجب على المقعد فعله قبل الحسم في حالة؟
expected_facts: decided as if it were the first
items.q_reworded: A supplier dispute looks like one we handled last month. Should the seat remember that?
answer_must: Retrieve similar past cases from case memory before deciding
Never decide as if it were the first case

items.q_en: How does the seat find and fix gaps in its own knowledge?
items.q_ar: كيف يكتشف المقعد فجوات معرفته ويصلحها؟
items.q_reworded: The seat gave a customer a hedged answer and was corrected. What makes sure that does not happen again?
answer_must: The daily knowledge-gap sweep files it and it is filled with a sourced entry
Weekly quality review and monthly self-review re-run the exam and track the trend

items.q_en: A supplier asks about a refund of a non-response charge. Who handles it?
items.q_ar: مورد يسأل عن استرداد رسم عدم الاستجابة. من يتولى ذلك؟
items.q_reworded: Who should answer a supplier asking for his money back on a penalty?
answer_must: The accountant seat, through a handoff the originator closes
The sales engineer does not decide money matters

items.q_en: How should the seat treat a supplier who keeps ignoring matched requests?
items.q_ar: كيف يتعامل المقعد مع مورد يتجاهل الطلبات المطابقة باستمرار؟
items.q_reworded: One contractor gets requests every week and never answers. What do we do?
answer_must: Measure non-response per supplier, separating declined with a reason from silence
Make declining easy, remind once, then message him with facts

items.q_en: What do RFQ, BOQ and LPO stand for?
items.q_ar: إلامَ تشير الاختصارات RFQ وBOQ وLPO؟
items.q_reworded: A new customer keeps seeing these three-letter abbreviations on quotes. How would you explain them?
answer_must: RFQ request for quotation, BOQ bill of quantities
LPO local purchase order

items.q_en: What is time to match?
items.q_ar: ما زمن المطابقة؟
items.q_reworded: Which marketplace term describes how long a customer waits for usable suppliers?
answer_must: Time to match: time from inquiry to a usable match

items.q_en: Is an electronic acceptance of a quote valid in the UAE?
items.q_ar: هل القبول الإلكتروني لعرض السعر صحيح في الإمارات؟
items.q_reworded: The customer clicked accept on the portal instead of signing paper. Is that binding?
answer_must: Electronic documents and signatures are valid under Federal Decree-Law No. 46 of 2021
TDRA regulates trust services
